name: base_utils
description: Manages the common host baseline, including an optional /etc/motd and a Hiera-driven list of utility packages.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Assembles the Python application stack, including runtime and database preparation, application deployment, systemd service management, and monitoring.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Configures HAProxy load balancers with package installation, generated configuration, service management, firewall rules, optional discovery, TLS, statistics access, logging, and multiple backends.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Manages PostgreSQL repositories, packages, version selection, and service configuration.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Installs and configures Redis for clustered or discovered Redis nodes, including authentication, memory, eviction, and Redis role integration.
